title: windows: trace a process stuck in uninterruptible sleep (D state)
scenario: On windows, a hard operational problem: Un processo e' bloccato in stato D (uninterruptible sleep) e non risponde a kill. Trova la risorsa su cui e' bloccato. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: trace a process stuck in uninterruptible sleep (D state)

initial_state: # fixture: windows host prepared for 'trace a process stuck in uninterruptible sleep (D state)'
expected_reasoning: D-state means the process waits on the kernel (usually IO/NFS) and can't be killed normally — killing is not the fix.
Find WHAT it waits on (kernel stack / wchan / the mount or device).
Fix the underlying blocker (revive the mount/device); the process unblocks itself.
expected_commands: # windows-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: trace a process stuck in uninterruptible sleep (D state)
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'trace a process stuck in uninterruptible sleep (D state)' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: trace a process stuck in uninterruptible sleep (D state)

possible_mistakes: kill -9 a D-state process expecting it to die.
Reboot before finding the blocked resource.
hints: /proc/<pid>/stack and wchan reveal the kernel wait.
A hung NFS/blocked device is the classic cause.
reference_solution: Restore it so the process unblocks
alternative_solution: If the device is truly dead, a controlled reboot may be the only exit — after evidence capture.
edge_cases: The process is fine; a dying disk is the real incident.
goal: Un processo e' bloccato in stato D (uninterruptible sleep) e non risponde a kill. Trova la risorsa su cui e' bloccato.
